expertiseSources.summary: Defines constraints, non-goals, acceptance criteria, security requirements, rollout boundaries, and optional actual agreement evidence bound to a specification version.

exception.rationale: The specification workflow prevents an unapproved draft or unavailable requester from becoming authorization for implementation. Optional agreement evidence must identify the actual approved specification version and review; earlier agreement cannot authorize a revised retention policy. Consequential policy, security, and rollout choices remain requester-owned and observable. This requests a safety exception, not invented agreement, completed review, or measured quality uplift.
